Synopsis:
Elia, the Belgian TSO, has secured a €1bn EIB loan — the largest EIB energy infrastructure loan ever in Benelux — to finance the Princess Elisabeth Island, an artificial offshore hub 45km off the Belgian coast designed to connect future offshore wind farms to the Belgian grid. The project is a long-term strategic buildout of renewable electricity infrastructure aimed at expanding offshore wind capacity, enhancing energy security, and supporting European competitiveness.
